_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
3/26 2:20PM - What a day out there! Thursday truly put on a show, and so did the snow. With soft spring turns to be had all day, it was definitely one to be here for. Tomorrow, we anticipate a slight adjustment to operations, as we’re expecting precipitation this evening and temperatures to dip below freezing around midnight. We expect surface conditions to be a bit firmer than today, with operational delays due to dropping temperatures, overnight precipitation and possible winds in the morning. While we don’t know exactly what to expect, be aware that lift and trail delays, or a potential delayed opening of the summit, are possible due to the expected overnight drop in temperatures. With all of this, the plan on paper is to run 9 lifts, adding Shooting Star to our Friday lineup, with 48 trails, all of which will get love from the grooming team overnight. Please note this plan is fluid and may change overnight. Be sure to go get some laps in at the Sun Bowl, as this will be the final weekend of operations on the east side of the mountain. Have a wonderful Thursday evening, and we’ll see you out here in the morning for Friday Fun Day.

The Nordic Center is now closed for the season. Thanks to everyone who joined us for another great season on the trails!

​Safety Tip: Please slow down in high traffic areas.

The Annual Pond Skim is right around the corner and it’s all going down this Saturday, March 28 at 11:30AM. Even if you’re not skimming, it’s still a fun one to watch with soft spring snow, sunshine, and a full morning of splashes.
